dense.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

score_storage: float32 from measured logits; no calibration claim
retrieval_input: NFC whitespace-normalized abstracts only; no source titles
seed_policy: preserve available old masked seeds; rebuild formerly missing seeds with identical legacy masking; retain all gate states

matching.cost: micro-units of dense percentile gap + reranker percentile gap + abs(log token ratio) + evidence-date gap/365
matching.objective: max cardinality then min declared integer nuisance cost; stable tie order

interpretation: fixed diagnostic thresholds selected before source-model scores; not human-validated relevance or scientific validity

f1.selection: deterministic round-robin source strata, one block per unique seed, no proposal outputs
